threshold_contradiction_frozen: Four or fewer sampled families enable the default and authoritative sources document an unresolved industry split; intermediate evidence is non-fulfilment or indeterminable if policies cannot be reconstructed.

speaker: Frank Rieger and Ron

indicator_frozen: Regulator or certification-body records, vendor advisories, CERT reports and contemporaneous technical research dated 2013.

verbatim_text: Vielleicht nicht nächstes Jahr, aber übernächstes Jahr ... wir brauchen bald Werbeblocker-Blocker-Blocker und die müssen natürlich auch so langsam intelligent werden, d. h., wir werden so eine verteilte Intelligenz bauen, die uns die Werbeblocker-Blocker blockt.

threshold_success_frozen: At least three independent teams publish qualifying demonstrations in 2014, spanning at least two channel categories.
threshold_contradiction_frozen: No qualifying demonstration appears in the year; one or two are non-fulfilment.
rationale: 'One of the essential issues for 2014' is operationalized as multiple independent practical demonstrations across the cited channel types, which is faithful to the examples. The count of three teams and two channel categories is a coder construct.

speaker: Frank Rieger and Ron
verbatim_text: 2012 wird es da wohl so eine kleine Rejustierung der Sicherheitswahrnehmung geben.
context_text: The referent is hardware authentication tokens presented as the last defence against malware; the speakers stress that they are ordinary processors running software.
atomic_restatement: During 2012, public technical evidence will materially revise confidence in hardware banking-authentication tokens by demonstrating an exploitable implementation flaw or practical authentication bypass.
indicator_frozen: A vendor advisory, researcher demonstration or peer-reviewed technical publication during 2012 shows code execution, secret extraction, transaction manipulation or an authentication bypass principally caused by a flaw in a dedicated hardware authentication token.
threshold_success_frozen: At least one qualifying public technical disclosure occurs in 2012.
threshold_contradiction_frozen: An authoritative review of 2012 token-security research identifies no qualifying disclosure; absence alone is non-fulfilment.
alternative_restatement: In 2012, there will probably be a small readjustment in how secure hardware authentication tokens are perceived.
rationale: 'kleine Rejustierung' (small) and 'wohl' (probably) become 'materially revise'. The perception shift is operationalized as a technical flaw demonstration, and the population narrows to banking tokens although the text refers to hardware tokens generally.

speaker: Frank_Rieger_and_Ron
verbatim_text: Angriffe zielen immer mehr auf das menschliche Gehirn; technische Angriffe werden zum Hilfsmittel.
context_text: This is presented as the conclusion of the attack-distribution forecast inside the next-year block.
atomic_restatement: During 2019, cyberattacks will increasingly target human cognition through social engineering, with technical compromise serving as an enabling instrument.
indicator_frozen: Comparable annual phishing, fraud and incident reports plus primary campaign analyses for 2018-2019.
threshold_success_frozen: A majority of at least three independent comparable sources show at least a 10% increase in phishing or social-engineering incidents or share in 2019 versus 2018, and at least one authoritative campaign analysis documents technical compromise used to enable cognitive manipulation.
threshold_contradiction_frozen: A majority of at least three comparable sources show a decline of at least 10% and no qualifying technically enabled campaign is documented; mixed evidence is indeterminable.
rationale: Both parts of the compound claim (more cognition-targeted attacks, technical attacks as an instrument) are preserved and tested jointly. The 10% threshold is a reasonable operationalization of 'immer mehr'.

speaker: Frank Rieger and Ron
verbatim_text: Ein scriptfähiges PDF wird die nächsten zwei, drei Jahre ein Renner, denn Behörden wollen in Zukunft nur noch auf solche PDFs aufsetzen, um darin alle Berechnungen zu machen.
context_text: The panel supplies a maximum three-year horizon and a mechanism: public authorities' use of script-capable PDFs for calculations and forms.
atomic_restatement: By 29 December 2013, script-capable or interactive PDF forms will become a prominent production format for calculation-bearing workflows in public authorities.
indicator_frozen: Official form repositories, procurement or technical guidance and archival public-service workflows document interactive PDFs using embedded calculations or scripts.
threshold_success_frozen: At least ten distinct public authorities across at least three jurisdictions publish or mandate qualifying calculation-bearing interactive PDF workflows by the deadline, or an authoritative sector-wide source identifies the format as common.
threshold_contradiction_frozen: Fewer than three authorities in every qualifying archival survey use such workflows; three to nine are non-fulfilment and insufficient archived forms are indeterminable.
alternative_restatement: Over the next two to three years, script-capable PDFs will be a 'hit' (likely as an attack vector) because authorities plan to base calculation workflows on them.
rationale: In a Security Nightmares context, 'Renner' plausibly means popular with attackers, with authority adoption given as the cause. The restatement makes adoption itself the outcome. The multi-jurisdiction threshold also broadens the implicitly German scope.

speaker: Alex Stamos
verbatim_text: We are going to have ... a greater number of endpoints that can be attacked directly ... route all the way to somebody's desktop.
context_text: The statement is part of the pros and cons of the predicted four-to-five-year IPv6 transition state.
atomic_restatement: By 26 July 2017, the number of internet-routable enterprise or consumer endpoints directly reachable over IPv6 will materially exceed its 2012 level.
horizon_literal: in the next four or five years
indicator_frozen: Using a frozen comparable active-measurement methodology, estimate responsive or otherwise directly reachable non-server endpoint addresses over IPv6 in 2012 and 2017, supplemented by provider address-assignment evidence; material increase means at least fivefold growth.
threshold_success_frozen: The comparable 2017 estimate is at least five times the 2012 estimate.
threshold_contradiction_frozen: The 2017 estimate is lower than 2012; growth below fivefold is non-fulfilment.
rationale: Faithful to 'greater number of endpoints that can be attacked directly' under IPv6 (end-to-end routability to desktops). The fivefold threshold is invented, but given IPv6 growth over 2012-2017 it is unlikely to be decisive.
